brief:
Start the local ~/.wiki FedWiki farm and serve it on the tailscale tailnet, and SYNC the full farm roster onto *.mitch.private.fish hostnames — "review my local wikis and give them to the network". Use when the user says "start the wiki farm", "serve the wikis on tailscale/the tailnet", "share my local wikis", "sync the farm to the network", or asks what's currently shared. Covers start/status/sync/off/peers, the port + hostname door map, verification probes, and the encoding/startup gotchas.

One orchestrator puts the whole local FedWiki farm on the tailnet (tailnet-only, WireGuard-encrypted, never public; Funnel deliberately unused):

| action | what it does | |---|---| | `start` | farm (:3030) + host-rewrite proxy + tailscale serve maps + auto-sync. Idempotent, detached (survives sessions). | | `sync` | **review the farm and give it to the network**: every populated `*.localhost` site → `<name>.mitch.private.fish` (dots→dashes), written to `~/.wiki/_tailnet_sites.json`. The proxy re-reads the file within ~2s — no restart. Prints the full roster. | | `status` | farm/proxy up? + `tailscale serve status` | | `off` | remove tailscale serve maps only (farm + proxy keep running) | |…
